questions.prompt: In flag → exclusive scan → scatter compaction, where does a kept element at index i go?
questions.explanation: The exclusive scan counts kept elements before i.

questions.prompt: Why must each pass of an LSD radix sort be stable?
options: So keys with equal current digits keep the order established by the earlier (less significant) passes
questions.explanation: Stability carries the earlier passes' ordering forward.

questions.prompt: How many passes does an LSD radix sort of 32-bit keys with 4-bit digits need?
A straightforward pass reads keys twice and writes once. For 32-bit keys with 8-bit digits, how many times is each key moved through DRAM over the whole sort? (Count reads + writes.)
Inside a warp, how can a lane find its rank among lanes with the same digit d (and lower lane ids)?
options: Loop over all keys in global memory
Ballot (digit === d), mask to lower lanes, count the set bits
questions.explanation: popcount(ballot & lanemask_lt) is the classic trick.

questions.prompt: How do you radix-sort IEEE floats correctly?
options: Transform the bits so their unsigned order matches numeric order (flip the sign bit for positives, all bits for negatives)
questions.explanation: A reversible bit transform makes floats sort as unsigned integers.
